description: This file defines the fancyBox jQuery plugin, version 2.1.5, including its default settings, helper functions, transition effects, overlay management, and plugin initialization. It enables modal image and content display with various effects and controls.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the fancyBox with specified group and options.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Navigates to the next item in the gallery.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Navigates to the previous item in the gallery.

methods.name: jumpto
methods.description: Jumps to a specific gallery item by index.

methods.name: reposition
methods.description: Centers the fancyBox inside the viewport.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the dimensions and position of the fancyBox.
